input_ref: Pharmacy advocate: OOP wording, does the estimate cover the copay or coinsurance

output.reason: This unit fully answers the question: say the quoted estimate reflects what the plan record shows for copay or coinsurance, and do not promise the register price. U-RX-EDU-001-10 gives the same core wording but leaves out that caveat. U-RX-EDU-001-09 is the general pricing disclaimer and does not address copay or coinsurance.
